falsification_conditions.condition: The asset's price closes above the previous 52-week high by more than 10% within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A significant breakout would indicate a strong trend contrary to the HOLD signal, invalidating the current verdict.

falsification_conditions.condition: Daily trading volume exceeds the 200-day average by more than 200% within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A surge in volume suggests heightened market participation or a potential trend reversal, contradicting the HOLD signal.

falsification_conditions.condition: The central bank (e.g., Fed) announces an unexpected rate cut of ≥50 basis points within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Such a policy shift would likely trigger a market move contrary to the HOLD, proving the current call incorrect.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
